guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice shows the dominant anomalies: latency-90 up 867% (z=+173), latency-50 up 780%, and CPU up 656% (z=+67), while its memory rose only 14.8% and no other service shows a comparable shift. Its downstream productcatalogservice latency is flat (+2.1%), so the slowdown originates in recommendationservice itself, and the CPU surge matches a CPU fault rather than socket, delay or loss.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate and relieve CPU saturation on recommendationservice: check for runaway processes or a recent deploy, then restart or scale out the recommendationservice pods and raise their CPU limits if needed.
